checks.name: migration 28 is transactional, repeatable and preserves legacy business rows
SAVE_DRAFT persists one report and leaves FINISHED/PENDING result and standings unchanged
report field limit and optimistic version are enforced consistently
failure before official result approval rolls back report version, result, standings, receipts and SSE
late realtime failure rolls back report approval, result, match, standings, receipts and notification
one appointed referee prepares and atomically confirms; retry/double-click return one approved version
SSE publishes committed approval; no event was emitted for the failed transaction
canonical snapshots include score, periods, players, events, clock and crew/context at submission
approved report history remains unchanged after current lineup/event data changes in QA
backend restart and reload retain report/version/result/history exactly
MANAGE_REPORT support prepares ordinary pending report without routing it to BTC or approving result
MANAGE_REPORT without FINALIZE cannot confirm; unrelated BTC cannot act as final authority
final authority can request corrections from the preparer without sending an ordinary report to BTC
final authority confirms support submission once; timeout retry and parallel requests return same approved report
explicit exception stays pending for organizer and final authority cannot bypass organizer review
organizer requests revision and new submission preserves prior snapshot and review history
official five business databases remain unchanged throughout QA
